subject.title: fix(agents-bind): generate peer format for feishu group bindings

question: Which Feishu `--bind` grammar should OpenClaw support for conversation peer ids while preserving the shipped `channel:account` CLI contract?
rationale: The observable bug needs peer-shaped Feishu conversation bindings, but choosing between explicit peer syntax and channel-specific id recognition changes public CLI grammar and upgrade behavior.

options.title: Preserve account syntax, add explicit peer syntax
options.body: Keep `feishu:<account>` as account binding and add a documented peer form such as `feishu:group:<id>` or another explicit peer grammar.

options.title: Use Feishu id recognition
options.body: Treat recognizable Feishu conversation ids as peers while preserving unknown values as account ids and documenting the recognition rules.

options.title: Pause this candidate
options.body: Hold this PR while maintainers select or sponsor the safest canonical fix among the linked candidate PRs.

recommendation.title: Preserve account syntax, add explicit peer syntax
recommendation.body: Keep `feishu:<account>` as account binding and add a documented peer form such as `feishu:group:<id>` or another explicit peer grammar.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans public agent CLI docs and routing semantics, both recently touched by this owner signal.
